items.title: Regularity descends from the composition along a flat map surjective on spectra
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in a composition of ring maps, if the total map is regular and the middle map is flat and surjective on spectra, then the first map is regular. The proof first obtains flatness of the first map from the flatness permanence result. Then, at a prime of the base, the base change of the middle map along the residue field extension is again flat and surjective on spectra, so the base change of the fibre of the first map is geometrically regular by the corresponding descent statement for geometric regularity, which is the required condition.
